scopes.process: parent monotonic clock around Popen launch through wait4 exit; stdin parsing/output included; temp-file preparation excluded
scopes.preloaded: child monotonic clock around repeated calls and weighted checksum; setup/parsing/formatting excluded; boundary and safety checks retained
scopes.preloaded_control: same loop and checksum reading expected results; a harness floor only, never subtracted
scopes.memory: wait4 peak RSS of each entire child including startup, parsing/preload, warmup and measurement; not auxiliary algorithm storage
